name: n8n-toolkit
description: Complete n8n GTM toolkit — workflow blueprints for inbound, outbound, signals, CRM sync, and lifecycle; MCP integration patterns; node design, error handling, and production deployment. Use when building n8n flows for GTM, connecting MCP servers to orchestration, or replacing Clay for complex branching. Triggers on: "n8n workflow", "n8n GTM flow", "n8n inbound", "n8n outbound", "n8n MCP", "build n8n automation", "n8n webhook CRM", "n8n enrichment pipeline".
